answer_1.quote: ...Our model can produce long meaningful captions as well as questions (like the ones in VQA datasets)...

answer_2.quote: ...We use Inception score (IS) to measure image diversity and Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) to measure authenticity... We use two variants of R-precision, R-prec-easy and R-prec-hard to evaluate if the image is well conditioned on the input text...

answer_4.quote: ...We conduct a human preference evaluations between X-LXMERT and the best performing model... 5000 image pairs were used, and 357 unique crowdworkers participated in total (median annotations per worker-17)...
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to select the image that best matches the caption (semantic preference) and the image that looks more realistic (fidelity preference).
